response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, oe.orderexecmark, oe.fillcount, o.recordvault FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault), g AS (SELECT channel, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS order_count FROM j GROUP BY channel) SELECT channel, avg_fillcount, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS order_fraction FROM g

assumptions.assumption: Executions are inner-joined to orders on ordersmark = recordvault; executions without a matching order are excluded. Orders with a NULL orderbase form their own group (NULL channel).

Orders are counted as distinct recordvault values (recordvault is unique per order). The fraction is each channel's distinct order count divided by the sum of per-channel counts, which equals the total distinct linked orders because each order has one channel.
